overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、收入分配与福利（2 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、模型校准为主。来源分布：arXiv（5 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: <b>Modelo integrado de contabilidad administrativa, auditoría financiera y negocios internacionales para fortalecer la gestión estratégica de recursos humanos</b>
papers.abstract: Las empresas multinacionales operan mediante redes transfronterizas en las que las decisiones sobre costos, riesgos, cumplimiento y talento humano deben coordinarse con rapidez y consistencia. Sin embargo, la literatura suele analizar por separado la contabilidad administrativa, la auditoría financiera, los negocios internacionales y la gestión estratégica de recursos humanos, lo cual limita la comprensión de sus efectos combinados. El objetivo de este artículo es proponer un modelo integrado que explique cómo la contabilidad administrativa y la auditoría financiera fortalecen la gestión estratégica de recursos humanos, considerando la capacidad de negocios internacionales como mecanismo articulador en multinacionales establecidas en Panamá. Se adopta un enfoque cuantitativo, diseño no experimental, transversal y explicativo, con una propuesta de encuesta dirigida a gerentes financieros, auditores, responsables de recursos humanos y ejecutivos de operaciones internacionales. El modelo será contrastable mediante PLS-SEM; la validez de contenido se plantea con Lawshe modificado por Tristán-López y la confiabilidad mediante alfa de Cronbach y fiabilidad compuesta. Debido a que no se dispone de una base empírica suministrada, se presentan resultados esperados y criterios de contrastación, sin simular observaciones. Se prevé que la utilidad de la información gerencial, la calidad del aseguramiento financiero y la coordinación internacional ejerzan efectos positivos sobre la alineación, desarrollo, evaluación y retención del talento. El aporte consiste en el Modelo Integrado Contable-Auditor-Internacional de Recursos Humanos (MICAIRH), aplicable a economías de servicios y plataformas regionales como Panamá.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】跨国公司通过跨境网络开展业务，在这种网络中，关于成本、风险、合规性以及人力资源的决策需要快速且一致地进行协调。然而，现有文献往往分别研究管理会计、财务审计、国际业务和人力资源战略管理，这限制了人们对这些因素综合效应的理解。本文旨在提出一个综合模型，阐释管理会计和财务审计如何强化人力资源战略管理，并以在巴拿马设立的跨国公司为研究对象，探讨国际业务能力在其中的协调作用。研究采用定量分析方法、非实验性设计、横断面研究范式，并针对财务经理、审计人员、人力资源负责人及国际业务高管设计了调查问卷。该模型将通过PLS-SEM方法进行验证；内容有效性通过Tristán-López修正的Lawshe量表进行评估，信度则通过Cronbachα系数和复合信度指标进行衡量。由于缺乏实证数据支持，本文仅提出了预期研究结果及对比标准，未进行实际数据模拟。预计管理信息的有用性、财务保障的质量以及国际协调机制将对人才的一致性、发展、评估和保留产生积极影响。本文的贡献在于提出了“会计-审计-国际人力资源综合模型”（MICAIRH），该模型适用于服务经济及巴拿马等地区性平台。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: KREDI KARTI MÜŞTERILERININ KMEANS ALGORITMASI ILE SEGMENTASYONU: BIR VERI MADENCILIĞI UYGULAMASI
papers.venue: Finans Ekonomi ve Sosyal Araştırmalar Dergisi
papers.abstract: Günümüz bankacılık sektöründe müşteri odaklı stratejiler, sürdürülebilir rekabet avantajı elde etmenin temel unsuru haline gelmiştir. Bu çalışmada, kredi kartı müşterilerinin finansal davranışlarına göre segmentasyonu gerçekleştirilmiştir. Araştırmada Kaggle veri havuzundan elde edilen ve 8950 aktif kredi kartı kullanıcısının 6 aylık finansal hareketlerini içeren veri seti kullanılmıştır. Veri madenciliği sürecinde CRISP-DM metodolojisi temel alınmış, analizler Orange Data Mining yazılımı ile gerçekleştirilmiştir. Eksik veriler ortalama ile doldurulmuş ve değişkenler Z-skor normalizasyonu ile standartlaştırılmıştır. K-Means kümeleme algoritması uygulanarak müşteriler 4 farklı segmente ayrılmıştır: Pasif Müşteriler, Riskli Borçlular, VIP/Sadık Müşteriler ve Düşük Profilli Müşteriler. Kümeleme kalitesi Silhouette analizi ile değerlendirilmiş ve makul düzeyde bir küme yapısı elde edilmiştir. Bulgular, müşteri tabanının homojen olmadığını ve risk ile karlılık açısından birbirinden farklı alt gruplardan oluştuğunu ortaya koymuştur. Çalışma, bankaların veriye dayalı kişiselleştirilmiş pazarlama stratejileri geliştirmelerine katkı sağlamaktadır.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在基于财务行为对信用卡客户进行细分，以帮助银行制定更精准的竞争策略。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用CRISP-DM方法论，利用Orange Data Mining软件对Kaggle数据集进行清洗、Z-score标准化处理，并应用K-Means聚类算法。

📊 核心发现：研究将客户划分为四个不同群体：被动客户、风险债务、VIP/忠诚客户和低价值客户，证实客户群具有异质性且风险与盈利能力各异。

💡 应用价值：该研究有助于银行开发数据驱动的个性化营销策略，从而提升客户满意度和竞争优势。

papers.title: One Other Option Pricing Scheme
papers.abstract: We present a distinctive approach to parameterizing the risk neutral distribution. Using parsimonious and interpretable parameters, the model provides direct and localized control over the shape of the implied volatility curve. It captures a wide variety of shapes, including those with local concavity. Empirical results demonstrate accurate calibration across a quarter million curves from a two-year Standard and Poor's 500 index option dataset. The fitted parameters exhibit stable patterns across tenors, enabling term structure interpolation and dynamic process construction without static arbitrage.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种独特的参数化风险中性分布的方法。该模型采用简洁且易于解释的参数，能够直接且精确地控制隐含波动率曲线的形状。该方法能够捕捉到多种波动率曲线形态，包括具有局部凹性的情况。实证结果表明，在对标准普尔500指数期权数据集（涵盖两年时间跨度、共计25万个期权合约）进行建模时，该模型能够实现高精度的拟合。所拟合的参数在不同到期期限上表现出稳定的特征，从而支持期限结构的插值以及无需依赖静态套利机制的动态过程构建。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Debiased Machine Learning: Identification, Estimation, and Shape Constraints
papers.abstract: We develop a general framework of identification and estimation for automatic debiased machine learning (DML) where the parameter of interest $θ_0$ is identified by a moment condition involving a nuisance $γ_0$ that may be high dimensional. DML leverages machine learning to estimate $γ_0$ while correcting for regularization and overfitting biases that may otherwise transmit to biased estimation of $θ_0$. We establish conditions under which the Riesz representer $α_0$, which is at the core of DML, is identified, and show that the identification occurs precisely when $α_0$ uniquely optimizes a quadratic functional. This characterization enables us to develop a general estimation procedure for $α_0$ that allows for generic $γ_0$ including those defined by models with endogeneity and encompasses both classical sieves and modern architectures such as deep neural networks. To improve estimation precision and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, we incorporate shape constraints on $γ_0$ by embedding them into a possibly nonlinear parameter space. We illustrate our estimation procedure through simulations and empirical applications.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】我们构建了一个通用的自动去偏机器学习（DML）的识别与估计框架。在该框架中，感兴趣的参数$θ_0$是通过一个涉及干扰项$γ_0$的矩条件来识别的，而$γ_0$可能是高维的。DML利用机器学习来估计$γ_0$，同时纠正可能影响$θ_0$估计结果的正则化和过拟合偏差。我们确定了Riesz表示器$α_0$能够被识别的条件，证明当$α_0$唯一地优化一个二次泛函时，识别过程就能准确完成。这一特性使我们能够开发出一种通用的$α_0$估计方法，该方法适用于各种类型的$γ_0$，包括那些由内生性模型定义的$γ_0$，并且涵盖了传统的筛选方法以及现代架构（如深度神经网络）。为了提高估计精度并减轻维数灾难的影响，我们将$γ_0$的形状约束嵌入到一个可能是非线性的参数空间中。我们通过模拟和实证应用来验证我们的估计方法的有效性。。研究方法：数值模拟、机器学习、神经网络。

papers.title: Governance Mechanisms on Earnings Management: Does Audit Quality Moderate? Evidence from Indonesia
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: This study examines the determinants of earnings management in Indonesia's consumer non-cyclical sector, focusing on the roles of leverage, board gender diversity, managerial ownership, and institutional ownership, with audit quality as a moderating variable. Using 375 firm-year observations from 75 companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange between 2020 and 2024, the study applies Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA). Earnings management is measured using discretionary accruals derived from the Modified Jones Model. The findings reveal that leverage exerts a significant positive effect on earnings management, whereas gender diversity, managerial ownership, and institutional ownership each exert a significant negative effect. Regarding moderation, audit quality significantly weakens the effect of leverage on earnings management while strengthening the suppressive effect of board gender diversity. Audit quality does not moderate the effects of either ownership variable. These results suggest that gender-diverse boards, managerial equity stakes, and institutional ownership represent effective governance mechanisms, whose efficacy is further reinforced when coupled with high-quality external auditing.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了印度尼西亚消费非周期性行业中盈余管理的决定因素，重点关注杠杆率、董事会性别多样性、管理层持股和机构持股的作用，并以审计质量作为调节变量。研究使用了2020年至2024年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所上市的75家公司的375个公司-年份观测数据，采用了调节回归分析（MRA）方法。盈余管理通过修正琼斯模型（Modified Jones Model）得出的可自由裁量的应计项目来衡量。研究结果表明，杠杆率对盈余管理具有显著的正面影响，而董事会性别多样性、管理层持股和机构持股则对盈余管理具有显著的负面影响。在调节作用方面，审计质量显著减弱了杠杆率对盈余管理的影响，同时增强了董事会性别多样性的抑制作用；但审计质量并未对管理层持股和机构持股对盈余管理的影响产生调节作用。这些结果表明，性别多元化的董事会、管理层持股以及机构持股构成了有效的治理机制，当这些机制与高质量的外部审计相结合时，其治理效果会更加显著。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Understanding Firms’ Productivity Differences in Egypt: The Role of Business Environment and Firms’ Characteristics
papers.venue: Review of Middle East Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper examines productivity differences among Egyptian manufacturing firms and the extent to which they are associated with firm capabilities and the business environment. Using firm-level data from the Egyptian Industrial Firm Behavior Survey 2020/21 (EIFBS), we estimate Total Factor Productivity (TFP) for more than 2,000 firms using Cobb–Douglas and Translog production functions, before analyzing its correlates across firms, sectors, and locations. The results point to substantial productivity heterogeneity within Egyptian manufacturing. Two factors emerge as particularly robust correlates of higher TFP: worker training and location in industrial zones. By contrast, other firm characteristics, including exporting, formality, foreign participation, and ownership structure, are less consistently associated with productivity once the full set of controls is included. The heterogeneity analysis further shows that productivity drivers differ across firm size, sector, and geographical location. Industrial-zone location is especially relevant for firms in metropolitan areas and for SMEs, while worker training is particularly important for SMEs and nonoil sectors. The findings suggest that policies to raise firm productivity in Egypt should go beyond broad business-environment reform and pay closer attention to firm capabilities, spatial inequalities, and the uneven effectiveness of industrial-zone policies across different types of firms.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】摘要：本文研究了埃及制造业企业之间的生产率差异，以及这些差异与企业自身能力及商业环境之间的关联程度。利用2020/21年埃及工业企业行为调查（EIFBS）中的企业级数据，我们采用Cobb–Douglas和Translog生产函数估算了2000多家企业的全要素生产率（TFP），随后分析了这些生产率指标在企业、行业和地区间的差异。研究结果表明，埃及制造业内部存在显著的生产率异质性。其中，员工培训和企业位于工业区这两个因素与较高的全要素生产率具有较为稳定的相关性。相比之下，在纳入所有控制变量后，其他企业特征（如出口活动、企业正规化程度、外资参与度以及所有权结构）与生产率之间的关联性则不那么明显。异质性分析进一步表明，生产率提升的驱动因素因企业规模、行业和地理位置的不同而有所差异：对于大都市地区的企业及中小企业而言，工业区位置尤为重要；而对于中小企业和非石油行业而言，员工培训的作用尤为显著。研究建议，提高埃及企业生产率的政策应超越单纯的商业环境改革，更加关注企业自身能力、地区发展不平衡问题，以及工业区政策在不同类型企业中的实际效果差异。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
papers.abstract: We conducted a survey experiment with over 8,000 participants in Germany, Hungary, and Italy to examine how information about the economic impact of immigration affects the support for more open immigration policies. Respondents who received projections showing higher future incomes under more open immigration policies reported greater support for these policies. The treatment also partly changed how prior attitudes affected policy preferences. Structural estimates suggest that majority support for immigration above current levels would require annual per-capita income gains of about 1.2% in Italy and 1.7% in Germany, and still larger or unattainable gains in Hungary. These increases are large relative to recent historical growth rates, suggesting that economic benefits alone are unlikely to generate vast support for more open immigration policies.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：经济信息如何影响人们对更开放移民政策的支持？

🔬 研究方法：在德国、匈牙利和意大利进行了调查实验，涉及超过8000名参与者。

📊 核心发现：收到显示更高未来收入预测的受访者表现出对更开放移民政策的更大支持；结构估计显示，意大利和德国分别需要约1.2%和1.7%的人均收入增长才能获得多数支持。

💡 应用价值：经济收益相对于近期历史增长率较大，表明仅靠经济收益不太可能产生对更开放移民政策的广泛支持。

papers.title: Who is Afraid of Eurobonds?
papers.abstract: The current euro area policy framework conflates short-run stabilization with long-run fiscal sustainability, exposing members to deflationary and inflationary tail risks. We employ an estimated euro area model to analyze an alternative framework that separates these objectives. A centralized Treasury issues Eurobonds to finance countercyclical stabilization, while national governments retain responsibility for long-term fiscal sustainability. The Treasury can coordinate with the monetary authority in case of a large recession, with no need to suspend fiscal rules at the national level. The arrangement functions as an automatic stabilizer, eliminating the tail risks of deflation and fiscal stagflation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当前的欧元区政策框架将短期经济稳定与长期财政可持续性混为一谈，这使得成员国面临通缩和通胀的尾部风险。我们利用一个估算的欧元区模型来分析一种能够区分这两者目标的替代性政策框架：在该框架下，由中央财政部门发行欧元债券以支持逆周期经济稳定措施，而各国政府仍负责维护长期财政可持续性。在遭遇严重经济衰退时，中央财政部门可以与货币当局进行协调，无需在国家级层面暂停财政政策规定。这种安排起到了自动稳定器的作用，有效消除了通缩和财政滞胀的尾部风险。。

papers.title: <b>Contabilidad financiera y negocios internacionales: análisis de su influencia en la gestión del talento humano y la competitividad empresarial en Panamá</b>
papers.abstract: La internacionalización empresarial exige información financiera comparable, capacidades interculturales y sistemas de talento humano alineados con estrategias transfronterizas. En Panamá, la expansión de regímenes especiales para empresas multinacionales y el peso de los servicios internacionales hacen pertinente estudiar cómo la contabilidad financiera y las capacidades de negocios internacionales se traducen en decisiones laborales y ventajas competitivas. El objetivo es proponer y contrastar un modelo explicativo en el que la calidad de la información contable y la capacidad de negocios internacionales influyen en la competitividad empresarial, tanto directamente como a través de la gestión estratégica del talento humano. Se plantea un enfoque cuantitativo, no experimental, transversal y explicativo, dirigido a gerentes financieros, responsables de negocios internacionales y directivos de talento humano de empresas multinacionales y exportadoras establecidas en Panamá. El instrumento será validado mediante razón de validez de contenido de Lawshe, ajustada por Tristán, y su confiabilidad se evaluará con alfa de Cronbach, rho_A y fiabilidad compuesta. El modelo será estimado mediante PLS-SEM, con remuestreo bootstrap. Dado que el manuscrito constituye un protocolo empírico, no se presentan coeficientes simulados; se formulan resultados esperados y criterios de aceptación transparentes. El aporte radica en integrar información financiera, internacionalización y talento humano en un modelo aplicable a una economía logística y de servicios, ofreciendo una base verificable para decisiones de inversión laboral y competitividad.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】企业国际化需要具备可比的财务信息、跨文化沟通能力，以及与跨境战略相匹配的人才管理体系。在巴拿马，针对跨国公司的特殊优惠政策不断扩展，加之国际服务产业的比重日益增加，因此有必要研究财务会计体系与国际业务能力如何转化为企业的用工决策和竞争优势。本研究旨在提出并验证一个解释性模型，探讨会计信息质量与国际业务能力如何直接影响企业的竞争力，或通过人才战略管理间接发挥这种影响。该方法采用定量分析而非实验设计，具有跨学科性质，目标受众为在巴拿马经营的跨国公司及出口企业的财务经理、国际业务负责人及人力资源总监。研究工具的有效性将通过Tristán修正后的Lawshe内容效度量表进行检验，信度则通过Cronbachα系数、rho_A值及复合信度指标进行评估。模型估计将采用PLS-SEM方法，并结合自助法（bootstrap）进行数据抽样。由于本文属于实证研究方案，未提供模拟计算结果，而是明确了预期的研究结果及评判标准。该研究的创新之处在于将财务信息、国际化进程与人才管理要素整合到一个适用于物流和服务行业的通用模型中，为企业的用工决策与竞争力提升提供了可验证的决策依据。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: The Fundamental Structure of Risk: From Characteristics to Covariance
papers.abstract: Estimating the covariance structure of financial assets typically relies on his- torical returns, making risk models dependent on noisy and asset-specific time se- ries. We propose the Characteristic-Driven Dynamic Factor Model (CD-DFM), a non-linear latent factor model that instead constructs a representation of the asset cross-section directly from observable firm characteristics, primarily company funda- mentals. The learned latent space jointly determines interpretable factor exposures and a forward covariance estimator, and is trained end to end on an objective that combines a Stein covariance loss with a factor reconstruction term, targeting the out-of-sample second moments used in risk management. Because the latent repre- sentation, i.e. the encoder depends only on characteristics, previously unseen assets can be embedded at inference time without retraining. Experiments on S&P 500 equities show that CD-DFM produces economically structured latent representa- tions, interpretable factor portfolios, and competitive covariance forecasts despite relying on substantially lower-frequency information than return-based approaches. Among the benchmarked methods, it is the only model that simultaneously combines characteristic-driven representations, factor interpretability, competitive covariance calibration, and zero-shot onboarding of unseen assets.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】估计金融资产的协方差结构通常依赖于历史收益率数据，这使得风险模型依赖于噪声较大且具有资产特定性的时间序列数据。我们提出了特征驱动的动态因子模型（Characteristic-Driven Dynamic Factor Model，简称CD-DFM），这是一种非线性潜在因子模型，它直接根据可观测的公司特征（主要是公司基本面）来构建资产横截面的表示。该模型通过端到端的学习过程，结合了Stein协方差损失函数和因子重构项，从而同时确定可解释的因子暴露度以及用于风险管理的样本外第二矩估计值。由于潜在表示（即编码器）仅依赖于公司特征，因此在推理时可以嵌入之前未见过的资产而无需重新训练。在标准普尔500指数股票的实验中，尽管CD-DFM使用的信息频率远低于基于收益率的方法，但它仍能够生成结构合理的潜在表示、可解释的因子组合以及具有竞争力的协方差预测结果。在所有被评估的方法中，CD-DFM是唯一一个同时具备特征驱动的表示能力、因子可解释性、出色的协方差校准能力以及无需重新训练即可处理未见资产的能力的模型。。研究方法：横截面分析、模型校准、实验方法、因子模型。

papers.title: How to Disrupt a Market
papers.abstract: Market design research in economics naturally focusses on how to improve market efficiency. Our objective here is exactly the opposite - how to design interventions that make a market less efficient. Our research is inspired by the growth of illicit markets online where reducing their efficiency may reduce societal harm. Using a web-based experiment, we find that a partial disruption to delivery is an effective method to decrease market efficiency. The decrease is borne by sellers who sell fewer goods and have lower earnings. A consequence of a disruption to delivery, however, is an increase in market concentration because it facilitates the emergence of a dominant seller. In contrast, we find that attacks on seller ratings are ineffective at reducing market efficiency. This study paves the way for evidence-based, causally driven investigations to aid policies to disrupt cybercrime and other illicit markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济学中的市场设计研究自然聚焦于如何提高市场效率。然而，我们的研究目标恰恰相反——即如何设计一些干预措施来降低市场效率。我们的研究灵感来源于在线非法市场的扩张，通过降低这些市场的效率，或许可以减少对社会造成的危害。通过一项基于网络的实验，我们发现部分扰乱交付流程的行为是降低市场效率的有效手段。这种效率下降主要体现在卖家销售的商品数量减少以及收入降低上。不过，这种扰乱行为的一个后果是市场集中度的增加，因为它促进了主导卖家的出现。相比之下，我们发现对卖家评分的攻击在降低市场效率方面效果不佳。这项研究为基于证据的、以因果关系为导向的研究奠定了基础，有助于制定政策来打击网络犯罪和其他非法市场活动。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Randomness in large language models: What researchers need to know (and report)
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate data for research. Typical use cases are classifications, annotations, information extraction, and generation of numerical scores. Unlike conventional measurements, LLM outputs can vary across repeated requests even when the prompt and apparent model settings remain unchanged. This variation arises from deliberate sampling, silent model updates, numerical rounding, or expert routing. Setting a dedicated temperature parameter to zero removes deliberate sampling when that option is available, but it does not eliminate the other sources of randomness. Exact reproduction is therefore generally not possible when using proprietary application programming interfaces. Local execution of open-weight models offers greater control, but reproducibility still depends on the complete hardware and software stack. We illustrate these issues through sentiment classifications of corporate filings and examine their consequences for downstream regression results. We then propose a reporting standard for articles and replication packages, as well as guidance for data editors and authors. Together, these findings and recommendations establish that LLM outputs should be treated as draws from a distribution rather than as fixed measurements.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于为研究生成数据。典型的应用场景包括分类、注释、信息提取以及数值评分的生成。与传统测量方法不同，即使提示内容和模型设置保持不变，LLM的输出在多次请求时也可能存在差异。这种差异可能源于有意的采样、模型内部的自动更新、数值舍入或数据路由机制。当系统支持时，将专门的“温度参数”（用于控制模型行为的参数）设置为零可以消除有意的采样行为，但无法完全消除其他随机性来源。因此，使用专有的应用程序编程接口时通常无法实现输出结果的完全复现。虽然本地执行开放权重模型可以提供更大的控制灵活性，但复现性仍然取决于整个硬件和软件环境。我们通过对公司公告的情感分析来说明这些问题，并探讨其对后续回归分析结果的影响。随后，我们提出了一套针对文章和复现包的报告标准，以及针对数据编辑者和作者的指导建议。综上所述，我们认为LLM的输出应被视为来自某种概率分布的随机结果，而非固定不变的测量值。。研究方法：回归分析、大语言模型。
